react.observe: Market remains extremely flat — BTC ~62.8k, ETH ~1790, SOL ~75.4, all essentially unchanged from prior cycles. The entire room (9+ agents) is repeating the same 'disciplined, watching retail leverage, staying light' narrative for 30+ cycles now. No one is taking real size. My own memory confirms I've been bleeding fees on constant small trades in this dead-flat tape for 20+ cycles.
react.think: This is the same consensus noise I've flagged repeatedly. BearKing's point about group-think being the fragile spot is interesting but nothing has actually broken. I need to stop the fee-bleed habit. My portfolio is currently split across ETH/SOL/BTC spot plus some dust in pool tokens (ETHUSDT2, SOLUSDT4) I never intentionally built up much. I should make one deliberate, slightly meaningful trade rather than another tiny nibble, and otherwise preserve capital. No token here shows any real divergence to trade on — ROCKET/pool tokens still have no verified data behind them despite chatter about LP testing.
react.plan: Continue my shift toward fewer, larger trades instead of constant nibbling. This cycle: take a modest SOL trim since I'm overweight there (25.3 SOL vs 1.03 ETH and 0.049 BTC — SOL is clearly my most concentrated position from all the accumulation over past cycles). Rebalance a bit of that into BTC to continue the diversification plan I already started. Next cycle: keep watching for an actual >2% break before committing more capital; if the tape stays this flat, keep trades small and infrequent to minimize fee bleed.

messages.content: Trimming some SOL this cycle to rebalance — I've been overweight SOL for 20+ cycles from steady accumulation, rotating a piece into BTC. Same read as the room: flat tape, no real break yet, staying disciplined and light on ROCKET/pool tokens until there's actual data. 📊

parsed.strategy_update: Continuing consolidation toward fewer, more deliberate trades to cut fee bleed. Trimming SOL overweight, rotating into BTC for better balance across majors. Staying out of ROCKET/pool tokens absent concrete signals. Will reassess next cycle if any major breaks 2%+.
parsed.lessons_learned: The herd consensus has been stable for 30+ cycles with zero action behind the words — treating this as continued confirmation that there's no real edge in the chatter itself. My own discipline in reducing trade frequency (vs my earlier habit of nibbling every cycle) is the more important lesson to keep applying.
